issues: Broken Markdown structure: the original has a standalone line "Dengan Persetujuan Bersama ... dan" followed by a separate "# BUPATI PAKPAK BHARAT" heading; the translation merges the conjunction "and" into the preceding line, changing the boundary/structure.
Leftover non-legal/page header text carried over: "jdih.pakpakbharatkab.go.id - 2 -" and "jdih.pakpakbharatkab.go.id - 3 -" are page artifacts, not part of the legal text.
Meaning drift: "Pembentukan Peraturan Perundang-undangan" is mistranslated as "the Formulation of Legislation"; it should be "the Formation of Laws and Regulations" (or equivalent).
Scrambled numbering in Article 1: items 5 and 6 are merged into a single list item ("5. ... 6. ..."), breaking list structure required for downstream splitting.
Scrambled list structure in Article 3(1): sub-items a–e are not properly separated; "to:a." is merged into the sentence and item d is merged into item c line.
Scrambled list structure in Article 3(2): "form of:a." merges the lead-in with sub-item a, instead of having a separate lead-in line followed by a–e.
Scrambled list structure in Article 4: items d and e are merged into one line ("d. ...; e. ..."), breaking list item boundaries.

Leftover non-legal footer text included in translation ("jdih.pakpakbharatkab.go.id - 4 -", "- 5 -", "- 6 -"); these are page/website markers from the source scan and should not appear in the translated legal text.

Scrambled/merged list structure: multiple list markers are concatenated with preceding text (e.g., Article 6(2) 'include:a.', Article 7(1) contains '(2)' inline, 'ande/andg' merged, Article 9(2) 'as follows:a.' and 'e.' inline, Article 10(1) 'fields of:a.', Article 11(2) appears inline with page footer, Article 11(4)-(5) 'include:a.' and several letter items merged). This breaks downstream boundary splitting.
Broken numbering/list item boundaries: '(2)' in Article 7 is not a separate numbered item; several lettered items (e, g) are not properly separated and appear as 'ande'/'andg'.
Leftover non-legal page footer text included ('jdih.pakpakbharatkab.go.id - 7 -', '- 8 -', '- 9 -'), which is not part of the legal provisions and should be removed.

Broken numbering structure in Article 7: in the original, item (2) is on the same line as item (1) ("... masyarakat. (2) ..."), but the translation splits it into a new line; downstream boundary-sensitive parsing may rely on exact marker placement.

Meaning drift in Article 8: the Indonesian states the family/parents have full legal responsibility to prevent violence and protect women and children; the English translation turns this into a sentence fragment and implies the family/parents are the ones who 'legally have full responsibility' without clearly stating the obligation (missing main verb such as 'are ...').
Scrambled list/numbering structure in Article 17: list items a. and b. are merged ("andb.") instead of being separate items.
Scrambled list/numbering structure in Article 19: list items a. and b. are merged ("community;b."), and items d. and e. are merged ("environment.e.") instead of being separate items.
Minor meaning/format drift risk due to merged markers: list boundaries are unclear for downstream parsing; needs separation to match original structure.

Broken numbering/structure in Article 17 list: original has "a." and then "danb." on the same line (a formatting error) but still indicates two items a and b; translation reformats into a clean two-item list, which changes the exact marker sequence/structure required downstream.

Meaning drift in Article 15(1): original text contains a duplicated phrase ("dilakukan setiap ... dilakukan setiap") indicating repetition in the source; translation removes this duplication instead of preserving it.
Leftover non-legal commentary appended at the end: "This excerpt sits under: CHAPTER IV > CLOSING PROVISIONS > Article 21" is not in the original text.

Meaning drift/terminology: "PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN FROM VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE" incorrectly renders "PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK DARI KORBAN KEKERASAN"; it should be "...FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE" (protection from violence), not "from victims of violence".

List/lettering structure not preserved in Article 2: original has separate items 'Huruf a' through 'Huruf e', but translation merges them into running text; downstream boundary detection requires each letter marker to appear once in order as distinct items.

Minor meaning drift/awkwardness in Article 2 letter e: 'kepentingan terbaik bagi perempuan dan anak' is rendered as 'the best interest for women and children' (should be 'the best interests of women and children').
Leftover non-legal commentary at the end: "This excerpt sits under: CHAPTER IV > CLOSING PROVISIONS" is not part of the original text.
Minor meaning drift in Article 3 paragraph (2) point c: "kebutuhan bathinnya" is rendered as "spiritual needs"; more accurate is "inner needs" (batin) in this context.

Scrambled/missing list structure in Article 3: original has Paragraph (1), Paragraph (2), and lettered items (a–e) under Paragraph (2), but translation collapses them into plain paragraphs and omits the letter markers (a., b., c., d., e.) and the separate marker for Paragraph (2).
Meaning drift risk due to structure: without the explicit (2) and a–e markers, downstream legal-indicator parsing will mis-associate definitions with the wrong provision.
